podcast.body: This was Faith No More's first album, released as an indie record in 1985, featuring Chuck Mosley on vocals. The song "We Care A Lot" also appeared on their second album. "The first was an indie record called We Care A Lot in 1985, and the second was on a slightly bigger label entitled Introduce Yourself in 1987."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Groups That Changed Their Front-Person and Survived
